filterRegistration.acceptance: Held-out joint residuals must fit the canonical top jointPixelUncertainty and lie inside the anchor hull. This is a visual correspondence allowance, not a statistical confidence interval or PCB dimensional tolerance.
filterRegistration.limits: The fit is bounded by the outer filter joints. Projected underside stubs remain underside observations, not top copper. Supply rails, nearby discrete joints, cable lands and hidden winding paths outside the hull remain unresolved. Comparison-specimen photos corroborate the two-row layout only; they provide no primary-specimen electrical assignment.
filterRegistration.scope: Primary-specimen filter joint-array correspondence. Cable-facing and logic-facing rows are distinguished by the cable and driver positions; the component-side left-to-right order reverses on the underside. Top observations are lead/solder entry estimates, not measured hole centres. This matches anonymous photo features, not L1 pin numbers or winding continuity.

gaps.text: The recorded +5 V strip joins the board-edge resistor leads. A continuous photo-resolved path from that strip to a particular filter joint is not established. Do not merge the large cable-side copper area with this strip across isolation boundaries or obscured sections.

The inner R4.2/R7/R8 leads share an underside strip; /GND is their common reference net. Its continuation to the filter is not established. The cable shield and large top copper areas are not interchangeable with logic ground without a visible connection.

Both resistor fits extrapolate laterally toward the filter and share R3 anchors. Small residuals within the resistor bank do not qualify filter registration. Raised top leads, winding arcs and underside solder joints must not be equated by nearest distance.
An underside joint without a recorded departure is not evidence of a power or ground winding. Preserve every winding pairing until a same-specimen terminal connection or winding path constrains it.
